title: Riegelmann Boardwalk and building line of Parcel F
previewText:
A street wall shall be located on Riegelmann Boardwalk street line and extend along the entire Riegelmann Boardwalk frontage of the zoning lot to a minimum height of 20 feet, as shown on Map 5 (Minimum and Maximum Base Heights). blocks.plainText: A street wall shall be located on Riegelmann Boardwalk street line and extend along the entire Riegelmann Boardwalk frontage of the zoning lot to a minimum height of 20 feet, as shown on Map 5 (Minimum and Maximum Base Heights). Any building or other structure within 70 feet of Riegelmann Boardwalk shall not exceed a height of 40 feet above the level of Riegelmann Boardwalk.

blocks.html: In addition, on Parcel F, a street wall shall be located on the Parachute Way building line and the portion of the Ocean Way building line that is within 100 feet of the Parachute Way building line, as shown on Map 4 (Street Wall Location). Such street walls shall extend along such entire frontages of Parcel F to a minimum height of 20 feet.
